title: MicroGPTEx: fresh install, docs wired
objective: Fresh-install devbin into MicroGPTEx (`~/Devel/prj/MicroGPTEx`, elixir) -- FIRST of the thread by hv's re-order (simplest), so this WP also proves the deps-drift protocol the rest reuse -- and wire the `docs` command to the project's real doc build. The project's own history already ruled its lua doc-build helper OUT of the language list (commit 2026-06-25) -- languages stay `[elixir]`, and the doc build is read at WP start, not assumed to be ex_doc.
body:

- Baseline -> `mix deps.update --all` -> green per protocol
- `docs` wired to the real doc build and demonstrated once
- `config.yaml` + authored help in their own commits

## Dependencies

- None -- first of the thread (hv's re-order, 2026-08-10); this WP proves the deps-drift protocol and folds any deviation back into design.md
